question: Is `update_partial` plus manual inspection and replanning an acceptable initial recovery contract for failed external package and Gateway mutations, or must this PR include durable operation identity and a doctor/retry/reconcile path before merge?
rationale: Automated review can verify the proposed fail-closed structure and tests, but cannot choose the product-level recovery guarantee operators should receive after an uncertain external mutation.

options.title: Require recoverable external updates
options.body: Require a durable operation identity plus a documented doctor/retry/reconcile flow and exact-head live proof before approving mutation support.

options.title: Accept guarded initial recovery
options.body: Accept `update_partial`, preserved uncertain provenance, and manual inspection/replanning as the experimental initial contract after exact-head live evidence demonstrates those failure paths.

options.title: Keep planning only
options.body: Land or retain the read-only planning stage but defer all update mutation support until the recovery model is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Require recoverable external updates
recommendation.body: Require a durable operation identity plus a documented doctor/retry/reconcile flow and exact-head live proof before approving mutation support.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing review comment identifies the precise recovery and live-proof decision that remains unresolved.
